scenario.opening_question: What matters most to you when choosing the wedding reception venue: ambiance, convenience, or cost?

options.name: Riverside Garden Pavilion
options.upside: Beautiful natural scenery with river views
options.tradeoff: Requires guests to travel farther from city center
options.concern: Weather could impact comfort despite pavilion cover

options.name: Downtown Loft Event Space
options.upside: Modern urban vibe with easy access for guests
options.tradeoff: Less natural light and no outdoor area
options.concern: Limited parking nearby could inconvenience guests

options.name: Historic Country Inn Ballroom
options.upside: Classic elegant atmosphere with vintage charm
options.tradeoff: Decor may feel outdated to some
options.concern: Venue restrictions on outside catering and decor

options.name: Botanical Conservatory Hall
